The project consists of three components: a model loader written in Rust, an offline operator compiler, and an HTTP service. The loader reads a single compressed weight bank and checks the tensor shapes before allocating GPU memory. If a file is missing or corrupted, it must return an error instead of starting with incomplete data.

Each request owns its key/value cache, recurrent state, convolution history, and token position. These states must never be shared between unrelated requests. A completed prompt may be reused only when its cache key and model configuration match exactly.

At 09:30 on Monday, Mina will test two simultaneous translation requests. At 14:45 on Tuesday, Daniel will repeat the test with eight requests and an 8,192-token input. The deployment should remain offline until both tests finish. Please preserve the identifiers ORIN-64 and CODE-641 exactly.
